name: One Arm Overhead Carry with March
instructions: Press a dumbbell overhead in one hand until your arm is locked out.
Stand tall with your ribs down and your glutes squeezed.
March in place or walk, lifting your knees without leaning.
Keep the dumbbell directly over your shoulder.
longevityNotes: Carrying is the most functional strength there is — groceries, luggage, a grandchild. Loaded carries build grip, posture, and core stability in one movement.
overview: A single-arm overhead carry with a marching step that trains shoulder stability and core control.
